The [official SDK manual](https://www.star-m.jp/products/s_print/sdk/webprnt/manual/en/_sampleProgram.htm) directs developers to serve the SDK JavaScript with their web content without modification.

The adapter loads these same-origin files on an explicit real print attempt. They are also part of the production application's asset cache. Update only from official Star distributions, review API/compatibility changes, preserve vendor notices, and refresh the recorded versions/hashes. Do not run Prettier on the JavaScript files.
